items.evidence: Government.nl confirms registration with the municipality within five days for residence over four months and issuance of a BSN. Wrong options name unrelated bodies/documents.
Government.nl confirms municipal notification from four weeks before through five days after moving and accepts a rental contract as proof of occupancy. Distractors are unrelated records.

Government.nl confirms DigiD as an online identity tool, advises against sharing login details, and supports authorisation with the representative’s own login. Distractors confuse DigiD with payment, travel, or a second identity.
Government.nl confirms compulsory standard insurance for people who live or work in the Netherlands and optional supplementary insurance. Travel and bicycle insurance do not compete.
Government.nl confirms 112 for urgent danger, 0900-8844 for non-urgent police help, and the operator’s core questions. Distractors reverse urgency or supply irrelevant information.
Government.nl confirms compulsory attendance ages 5–16, reporting illness to school, and advance headteacher permission for a wedding or funeral. Wrong options do not satisfy those duties.

Government.nl confirms a voting pass plus identity document, permits an identity document expired no more than five years, and places ballot completion in the booth. The revised wording removes the former validity and decision-location ambiguities.
Government.nl confirms local antidiscrimination services provide advice and assistance and that an offence can be reported to police. Distractors name bodies or actions without that role.
